scope: All 38 initial proc-only flags reviewed against actual descriptions and trigger graphs. No generic proc guessing; unchanged unresolved labels.

entries.name: Molten Shields
entries.reason: Ward-school-specific reflection window must be set from the ward cast; generic proc would not configure reflection school.

entries.name: Flame Throwing
entries.reason: Flagged spell 811100 is a downstream next-Fireball cast-time buff; its internal-cooldown and consumption lifecycle need wiring, not a blanket parent proc.

entries.name: Frost Channeling
entries.reason: XP/honor frost-kill eligibility and the 812519 periodic wrapper -> 812520 mana restoration duration require explicit validation.

entries.name: Adaptive Defense
entries.reason: Scoped event predicate and target/value handler implemented; compile, unit and negative-event policy checks passed. Existing ownership/rank paths unchanged.

entries.name: Improved Bloodrage
entries.reason: Defensive Stance condition, damage-reduction value and capstone Stagger clearing require linked custom logic.

entries.name: Fracture
entries.reason: Scoped event predicate and target/value handler implemented; compile, unit and negative-event policy checks passed. Existing ownership/rank paths unchanged.

entries.name: Commanding Presence
entries.reason: Battle/Commanding Shout dispatch and level-scaled Strength/Stamina values must be linked for both talent ranks.

entries.name: Malice
entries.reason: Scoped event predicate and target/value handler implemented; compile, unit and negative-event policy checks passed. Existing ownership/rank paths unchanged.

entries.name: Improved Power Word: Shield
entries.reason: Scoped event predicate and target/value handler implemented; compile, unit and negative-event policy checks passed. Existing ownership/rank paths unchanged.

entries.name: Copious Power
entries.reason: Triggered buff 965418 has a zero magnitude; must receive rank amount and consume on the next eligible cast-time heal.

entries.name: Reverberation
entries.reason: Must select the next DIFFERENT shock, exclude the originating shock, and consume the correct modifier.

entries.name: Tidal Mastery
entries.reason: Different critical healing spells add different Tidal Force duration increments; child trigger alone is insufficient.

entries.name: Improved Ghost Wolf
entries.reason: Capstone root/snare removal plus 20-second internal cooldown needs a cast-specific handler.

entries.name: Enhancing Totems
entries.reason: Child attack/spell power values are zero; must calculate level scaling and recognize actual totem placement.

entries.name: Shredding Attacks
entries.reason: Scoped event predicate and target/value handler implemented; compile, unit and negative-event policy checks passed. Existing ownership/rank paths unchanged.

entries.name: Emberstorm
entries.reason: Cooldown-reduction dummy triggers need Chaos Bolt target binding; mixed Wild Felfire trigger requires compatibility review.

entries.name: Improved Counterattack
entries.reason: Client parent and child descriptions disagree on cooldown timing; preserve parent behavior and review Killer Instinct cooldown linkage.

entries.name: Improved Blessing of Might
entries.reason: Must maintain self/one-ally ownership and replace the previously buffed ally while calculating level scaling.

entries.name: Sanctified Light
entries.reason: Blinding Light must arm a one-use critical modifier with the correct value and eligible heal consumption.

entries.name: Raging Berserker
entries.reason: Flag is in downstream aura 818501; its enabling/consumption path and AP-scaled lifesteal need review with the parent 820501.

entries.name: Improved Execute
entries.reason: Below-20-percent damage doubling and conditional stacking critical bonus must agree; proc-only repair does not cover full tooltip.

entries.name: Improved Berserker Stance
entries.reason: Conditional execute-range/enrage damage multiplier plus Raging Blow/Recklessness duration extension requires custom logic.

entries.name: Unrelenting Storm
entries.reason: Three-stack state must empower Chain Lightning and apply the target vulnerability; generic haste proc is incomplete.

entries.name: Empowering Frostbolt
entries.reason: Scoped event predicate and target/value handler implemented; compile, unit and negative-event policy checks passed. Existing ownership/rank paths unchanged.

entries.name: Fanaticism
entries.reason: Crusader Strike mark, Execution Sentence-dependent amplification, Judgement movement and PvE cooldown reduction form a multi-event chain.

entries.name: Improved Flash Heal
entries.reason: Cooldown trigger description refers to another ability; verify effect mapping to Inner Focus rather than trusting trigger name.

entries.name: Void-touched Mind
entries.reason: Dummy duration trigger references Divine Illumination; must explicitly link Mind Blast extension and Mind Flay stacking to Void Eruption.

entries.name: Shadow Power
entries.reason: Periodic Holy/Shadow capstone proc repaired. Baseline critical-damage modifier is zero in reviewed data and still requires separate review before whole-entry VERIFIED.

entries.name: Resourcefulness
entries.reason: Periodic trap/Black Arrow events must reduce three specific cooldowns; dummy trigger needs an explicit implementation.

entries.name: Spell Power
entries.reason: Below-50-percent mana condition, direct critical hit and 30-second cooldown plus critical-damage baseline need review.

entries.name: Netherwind Presence
entries.reason: Stacked haste needs seven spell-family roots and the full-stack Slow movement bonus; proc row alone is incomplete.

entries.name: Improved Earth Shield
entries.reason: Earth Shield healing must credit the caster, require final-rank Tidal Waves and observe five-second cooldown.

entries.name: Booming Echoes
entries.reason: Must select the matching shock school and triggered modifier, not always use the Nature variant.

entries.name: Improved Feral Spirit
entries.reason: Spirit Walk owner/pet relationship, rank-dependent dispel chance and both wolves Stormstrike empowerment must be linked.

entries.name: Wind Rush
entries.reason: Only a successful Wind Shear interruption should trigger haste; cast/hit alone cannot prove an interrupt occurred.

entries.name: Combat Readiness
entries.reason: Taking eligible hits must refresh the defensive stack and enforce the ten-second inactivity expiry, not just add a proc.

entries.name: A New Dawn
entries.reason: Per-caster healing vulnerability must consume on the next eligible heal from its original caster, with correct value.

entries.name: Wind Rush
entries.reason: Only a successful Wind Shear interruption should trigger haste; cast/hit alone cannot prove an interrupt occurred.
